name: back-office-agents
description: A collection of AI agent skills for back-office business workflows

skills.name: GL Account Flux Explainer
skills.description: Explains what drove the change in a GL account between two periods. Names the vendors, quotes the memos, flags currency and entity issues. Runs on a schedule or on demand. Delivers a timestamped Excel workbook.

skills.name: Change of Control Lease Extraction
skills.description: Reads a commercial lease package and extracts every Change of Control obligation — consent requirements, recapture rights, termination triggers, permitted transfers, fees — into a structured Excel summary with 20 standardized columns.

skills.name: Daily Close Trial Balance Roll-Forward
skills.description: Daily, self-scheduling trial balance by legal entity (with consolidated and roll-up views, translated into one reporting currency) built from either NetSuite or Excel/CSV files in SharePoint/OneDrive. Keeps a saved month-end baseline, reads only what changed each day, saves a dated Excel workbook, and emails a summary. Setup questions are asked once and stored in config.json so scheduled runs never ask anything.

skills.name: Contract Tabular Review
skills.description: Reads commercial contracts in full and extracts 20 key terms into a citation-backed Excel workbook. Every answer is tied to its source section. Includes an optional Change of Control deep-dive via the companion skill.

skills.name: Contract Dashboards
skills.description: Answers contract questions in plain language and keeps a live four-tab dashboard (Contract Reporting, Contract Requester, Cycle Times, Vendor Management) beside the chat. Builds from Agiloft, SharePoint/OneDrive spreadsheets, lists and Word/PDF documents, any other connected system, or an attached file, one source per dashboard. Confirms the field mapping before building, cites the filter behind every figure, and is read-only.
